opening.argument: The strongest evidence is the visible trial signup flow: the page offers “Try Prime Free” and a 30-day free trial, while the speaker tells viewers to select it. The subsequent payment-card and OTP screens appear within that flow, alongside a stated refundable ₹2 verification charge. These steps support an instructional demonstration of how to start the trial, not a claim that payment verification is unnecessary. A separate Telegram engagement request has an unclear purpose and relationship to the trial; on this record, it does not by itself establish a deceptive offer.
